seo.title: Kind words — Reviews of Rosewood Courtyard
seo.description: Read reviews from couples and companies who have celebrated at Rosewood Courtyard, rated 4.9 out of 5 across more than two hundred weddings and events.

props.heading: What our couples *remember*
props.body: We ask every couple for honest feedback a month after their wedding. Here is a little of what they have told us — unedited, apart from the occasional exclamation mark.

items.quote: We walked into the courtyard on a grey February afternoon and still knew within a minute. In June, with every rose out, it was beyond anything we imagined.
items.author: Imogen & Theo

items.quote: Clara, our coordinator, answered every one of our 214 emails with the same patience. On the day we didn’t make a single decision.
items.author: Priya & Sam

items.quote: The food was the thing our guests still talk about — the lamb, the late-night toasties, the strawberries from the walled garden.
items.author: Rosa & Daniel

items.quote: Having everyone stay in the Coach House turned a wedding into a whole weekend. Breakfast the morning after was our favourite meal.
items.author: Hannah & Joe

items.quote: We eloped with twelve people and it never once felt small. Just intimate, and entirely ours.
items.author: Ama & Lewis

items.quote: Our leadership retreat needed quiet, good coffee and no distractions. Rosewood gave us all three, plus a dinner the team still mentions.
items.author: Felicity Grant

items.quote: Thirty years married and we wanted to do it properly this time. The Orangery at dusk, our children making speeches — perfect.
items.author: Margaret & Alan

items.label: Regional Venue of the Year, Westward Weddings Awards
